plan.observation_endpoint: Verified final whistle of this game; postponement or abandonment requires an explicit pending disposition.
plan.scope: Seven existing questions only; bounded postgame assessment and closeout documentation.
plan.stop_rule: At the evidence deadline, finish with explicit unresolved findings or report blocked closeout. No recurring monitoring or automatic deadline extension.

questions.question: Can Arizona protect Brissett with its replacement offensive line against Dallas’s front?
questions.summary: Early Arizona disruption is supported by Brissett's four sacks, but Minshew's later production creates a different quarterback regime. The full-game result does not isolate protection quality or responsibility.
limitations: No complete final OL participation, pressure charting or block-responsibility film.
Quarterback change, defensive adjustments and injuries confound a causal explanation.
questions.next_action: Seek a final participation/gamebook witness and scoped pre/post-switch protection evidence; retain mixed if unavailable.

questions.question: Does Wilson retain or expand usable route participation after Brooks’s injury while managing ribs?
questions.summary: Wilson participated despite rib pain and caught eight passes. This establishes involvement, not retained or expanded usable route participation.
limitations: No verified routes, pass-play denominator or health-related route restrictions.
questions.next_action: Seek same-provider Week 8 route/participation evidence; preserve health uncertainty.

questions.question: Who receives the Arizona targets if the Brooks replacement changes deployment?
questions.summary: Arizona's QB and receiving rotation changed during the game. Wilson's production alone cannot distinguish target redistribution from conversion; no reconciled credited-target ledger was read.
limitations: Full box-score target tables failed to open; indexed counts remain unverified leads.
Bourne's exit and the QB switch complicate comparisons with the pregame baseline.
questions.next_action: Reconcile a complete same-provider target table and QB/personnel windows at the next checkpoint; otherwise close unresolved.

questions.question: Does Love return as a genuine receiving/early-down contributor or to a split, constrained role?
questions.summary: Love's return was interrupted by another ankle injury, and Knight also exited. Allgeier's subsequent work does not test a sustained healthy-Love receiving plan.
limitations: No verified routes, passing-down assignments, exit timing ledger or complete before-injury receiving opportunities.
questions.next_action: Separate availability from role; seek pre-exit usage and leave the healthy-role mechanism unassessed if absent.

questions.question: Can Dallas repeat useful early-down rushing against Arizona without Nolen?
questions.summary: Dallas's proposed efficient rushing path was challenged at team level: 39 rushes produced 93 yards (2.38 per attempt), and an early Williams fourth-and-one attempt failed. This is narrower than a verified Williams-only early-down success assessment.
limitations: Individual Williams totals were not reconciled from a full box; indexed sources conflict.
No full early-down success/down-and-distance inventory, box counts or blocking attribution.
questions.next_action: Confirm individual totals and scoped early-down results; preserve the narrow team-level finding without claiming a causal effect.

questions.question: Will Pickens have his normal receiving role alongside Lamb?
questions.summary: Pickens made a verified 37-yard catch, establishing actual offensive involvement. One play cannot establish a normal route workload alongside Lamb.
limitations: No complete snap/route ledger, successive-series workload or comparable healthy-role baseline.
questions.next_action: Seek a final receiver participation and route ledger; retain unresolved normality if unavailable.

questions.question: Can Dak handle Arizona’s disguised pressure when Dallas faces long passing downs?
questions.summary: Arizona produced a consequential overtime sack, but the original amended question concerns third-and-long pressure identification. Without a defined situational sample, that mechanism is unresolved.
limitations: No verified third-and-long threshold, full opportunity count, pressure classification or representative film.
The amended 31.4% pregame figure remains situational, never aggregate pressure.
questions.next_action: Seek scoped third-and-long play/pressure evidence or close the mechanism unresolved; do not infer disguise from a sack.
